verdict.rationale: Flagright documents separate regional API servers, eu-1 as the default and asia-1, which suggests customers can pick a region. The evidence shows this only for sandbox endpoints and never states that data is stored or kept in the chosen region. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or storage-location documentation, production regional endpoints, a list of available regions beyond eu-1/asia-1, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
